FISCAL NOTE

FN-G3DT7C6-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 287
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Tourism
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/30/2026
Senate Bill 287 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to the Consumable Hemp Product
Compliance Fund by an undetermined amount annually dependent on the number of Speciality
Retailer of Electronic Nicotine Delivery Systems permittees that choose to obtain the $1,000
retailer license for consumable hemp products, along with the corresponding $50 application
fee.
Page 1

FN-G3DT7C6-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 287
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Tourism
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/31/2026
Senate Bill 287 as reported by the Committee on Economic Development and Tourism could
increase receipts to the Consumable Hemp Product Compliance Fund by an undetermined
amount annually dependent on the number of Specialty Retailer of Electronic Nicotine Delivery
Systems permittees that choose to obtain the $1,000 retailer license for consumable hemp
products, along with the corresponding $50 application fee.
